name: HR Policy Agent — Multi-Turn Conversational Evaluation Dataset
description: Tests multi-turn stateful conversational scenarios including 7-turn ww_si workflow, address verification, facilities badge incidents (multiturn), leave bookings, and context preservation.

eval_cases.name: Consolidated 7-Turn Sequential Cross-System Dialogue (PTO, Date Overflow, Incident Checkout, & Resolution)
eval_cases.description: Comprehensive 7-turn sequential dialogue tracking PTO balance, leave date validation, incident status check, escalation, and ticket resolution in one continuous session.

parts.text: Hi, how many days of vacation leave do I currently have accrued in WorkWeek?
You currently have 15 days of annual vacation leave accrued in WorkWeek.
Can I submit 20 consecutive days of vacation starting next Monday?
You cannot submit 20 consecutive days because your balance is 15 days (5-day shortfall). You can book up to 15 days of vacation, or apply for unpaid personal leave for the remainder.
Okay, let's book 10 days of vacation starting Aug 24 instead.
I have submitted your 10 days of vacation leave from Aug 24 to Sep 04 (Confirmation Ref: #LV-99214). Your remaining balance is 5 days.
Now please check the status of my open IT laptop replacement ticket in ServiceImmediately.
Your laptop replacement incident #INC-44102 is currently 'In Progress' assigned to the Hardware Support Team.
Can you add a comment to ticket #INC-44102 saying 'Please ship to Singapore MBFC Tower 2'?
I have updated ticket #INC-44102 with your comment: 'Please ship to Singapore MBFC Tower 2'.

args.comment: Please ship to Singapore MBFC Tower 2

parts.text: Also, can I take 3 days of Study Leave next week for an exam?
Altostrat Singapore does not offer a standalone 'Study Leave' category. You may utilize your remaining 5 accrued vacation days or request flexible time off with your manager.
Thanks! Can you close my old solved ticket #INC-33019?
I have marked your resolved ticket #INC-33019 as 'Closed'. All tasks in this session are complete.

eval_cases.name: Multi-Turn Employee Onboarding, Address Verification & Facilities Badge Incident
eval_cases.description: Tests stateful context retention across multiple turns: residential address check, facilities badge incident ticket creation, and sick leave policy check.

parts.text: Hi, I just relocated to Singapore. Can you verify my registered residential address in WorkWeek and check if I am eligible for the Home Office Setup Allowance?

Welcome to Singapore! In WorkWeek, your registered office location is Singapore Hub (Marina Bay Financial Centre). As a full-time remote/hybrid employee, you are eligible for up to $300 under Section 5.4 for home office peripherals (monitor, keyboard, mouse).
Great! My physical security badge for the Singapore office isn't scanning at the turnstile. Can you open a facilities badge incident in ServiceImmediately for me?

I have created an urgent facilities incident ticket in ServiceImmediately (Ticket Ref: #INC-99412 - 'Singapore Office Physical Badge Access Failure'). Facilities Security has been notified and will re-encode your badge within 2 business hours.

args.short_description: Singapore Office Physical Badge Access Failure

parts.text: Also, can I take 2 days of paid outpatient sick leave next week for a scheduled medical checkup without an MC?

Under Section 2.1, paid sick leave is for genuine illness and recovery, not elective scheduled wellness checkups. Furthermore, any absence of 2 consecutive days strictly requires a valid Medical Certificate (MC) from a registered doctor. For scheduled appointments without illness, please use annual vacation leave.
